Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

surge chartography · human annotation: Chartography tasks are authored by working domain professionals with a target answer and a complete walkthrough of the visual readings and calculations; for visually estimated quantities, authors provide a chart-specific acceptable range. Each task is independently checked by three additional domain experts and retained only if screening elicits a meaningful failure in at least one frontier model.

Permanent record ID: candidate.add17.chartography.construction.v3

  • Ambiguous or unsupported tasks are revised or rejected; screening yields a deliberately difficult set rather than a random sample of professional chart questions.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

surge chartography · evaluates: Chartography supplies a chart and free-form question without tools, and uses Gemini 3.5 Flash to judge the final answer against expert targets and ranges without showing the judge the chart; multi-part answers are all-or-nothing.

Permanent record ID: candidate.add17.chartography.grading.v2

  • The paper reports twenty trials per task; the later README’s leaderboard instructions specify ten. Those trial configurations remain separate dated source scopes.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

surge chartography · dataset size: Chartography’s v1 paper describes one hundred task-image records using ninety-eight byte-distinct images; eighty-one records use online-sourced charts and nineteen use expert-created charts.

Permanent record ID: candidate.add17.chartography.units.v2

  • Task records, image files and source categories are different units within one retained benchmark family.
